reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brianna Angeline
reviewSamples.text: amazed! He did amazing and went out of his way for me. He came to my home to jumpstart my car and then returned it within a few hours. Even helped me with some car issues I had. My car looks shiny and smells great.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ryan
reviewSamples.text: Got an interior deep clean and couldn't be happier. He made my cars interior look brand new, got stains out of the seats, smelling good, perfect. Can't recommend enough.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of jan johnson
reviewSamples.text:
Wow Deshawn is amazing! He has done 2 different cars for me and now all the neighbors want him.
He has incredible talent, work ethic, business, and personal skills. He cares! …

reviewSamples.author: Photo of David White
reviewSamples.text: I've sold 5 cars now for myself and family members. Each time, I clean the car to the best of my ability, then have a detailer come by and do their thing so the car will sell at the best possible price. The price has always been in excess …

notes: Negocio de detallado movil, sin direccion fija publica (se omite mapa, se usa foto real). Owner/detallador identificado como 'Deshawn' via resena verbatim de Google y rotulo de contacto visible en una foto de flyer propia del negocio (gmaps-1.jpg original, descartada de la galeria final por tener texto superpuesto). Esa misma foto mostraba un telefono secundario '(863) 869-5805' y un email truncado 'dshawn941@g...' que no se pudo leer completo: no se uso ninguno de los dos por no poder confirmarlos; el telefono oficial usado en todo el site es el de la ficha de Google Maps (+1 863-362-9265), tratado como fuente de verdad. Se descarto ademas una foto de un van de 'Infinity Tire Supplies' (negocio de llantas no relacionado) que aparecia en el ciclo de fotos de Maps.
